name: Mingyue Huo
description: Mingyue Huo is a PhD candidate at UIUC working on speech and multimodal AI, foundation-model evaluation, and multi-speaker understanding.
bio: I am a PhD candidate in Computational Linguistics at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, advised by Prof. Yan Tang. I expect to graduate in December 2026.

My research focuses on speech and multimodal AI. I work on foundation-model evaluation and post-training, drawing on speech representation learning, multi-speaker understanding, and human speech perception.

This fall, I am a research intern at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL), working on long-form audio understanding. Previously, I interned at Netflix, Tencent AI Lab, Amazon Prime Video, and ByteDance AI Lab.
availability: I am seeking full-time Research Scientist roles and am available in Fall 2026.
interests: Evaluating and improving speech and audio-language models
Multi-speaker ASR, diarization, and target speech extraction
Speech representations and human-aligned speech understanding

experience.text: Long-form audio understanding in real-world multi-speaker meetings.
Diagnostic audio LLM judges, human preference supervision, and post-training for cross-lingual speech generation.
General-purpose speech representations and audio-language understanding; contributions to the Auden toolkit.
Text-guided target speech extraction and the TextrolMix dataset.
Mandarin and Japanese text-to-speech, singing synthesis, and perceptual evaluation.
